subject.title: Fix sessions.list for literal per-agent store paths

question: Should literal `session.store` paths that match `agents/<id>/sessions/sessions.json` be treated as same-root multi-agent discovery roots, or should literal paths remain single-store isolation by default?
rationale: The patch fixes the linked undercount, but it changes an existing config interpretation that may have been used as an isolation boundary.

options.title: Accept same-root discovery
options.body: Land the widened semantics after conflict refresh and focused checks, with maintainer-visible upgrade context.

options.title: Preserve literal isolation
options.body: Require a default-preserving implementation that only widens discovery through an explicit template, migration, or documented maintainer decision.

options.title: Replace the branch
options.body: Close or pause this stale dirty branch and open a narrow maintainer repair PR carrying the accepted semantics.

recommendation.title: Accept same-root discovery
recommendation.body: Land the widened semantics after conflict refresh and focused checks, with maintainer-visible upgrade context.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is prior work on the multi-agent session listing and canonical session-key path that this PR changes.
